waves.name: MAINJOB and its three programs
waves.rationale: The whole system is one job with one step that runs one program, which calls two empty subprograms. Splitting it gives waves that deliver nothing a stakeholder can name and have no testable boundary of their own.
waves.unblocks: Proves the toolchain and the test harness on a system with no data coupling. It also turns the OLDPGM dormancy question into an answered one, because wave 1 instruments it.
